{{Quote|Not for the faint of heart! This zesty slider features a patty topped with mouthwatering Zeltron pop-peppers, pink lettuce, magenta onions and spicy "pleasure planet" sauce. |Dex's Diner menu, on the Zeltros slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Magenta onions''' were a type of [[Onion/Legends|onion]] that was used by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] to make the [[Zeltros slider]]s that he sold at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magenta onions were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
